name: EHIVE
report: The attacker exploited a validation flaw between the stake and unstake functions. They created a position by staking nothing, waited 38 days, then took a WETH loan, swapped it to EHIVE, and sent it to initial contracts. By unstaking across all contracts, they received more WETH despite not having staked anything initially.
report_zh: 攻击者利用了质押（stake）和解除质押（unstake）函数之间的验证缺陷。他们通过质押零代币创建了一个头寸，等待38天，然后借入WETH贷款，将其兑换为EHIVE，并发送到初始合约。通过在所有合约中解除质押，他们虽然最初没有质押任何东西，却获得了更多的WETH。
